title: Discipline Your Son

questions.question: He who is often reproved, yet stiffens his neck, will suddenly be what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 29:1 (ESV): "will suddenly be broken beyond healing."

questions.question: When the righteous increase, the people rejoice, but when the wicked rule, the people do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 29:2 (ESV): "but when the wicked rule, the people groan."

questions.question: A fool gives full vent to his spirit, but a wise man quietly holds it what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 29:11 (ESV): "but a wise man quietly holds it back."

questions.question: Discipline your son, and he will give you rest; he will give delight to your what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 29:17 (ESV): "he will give delight to your heart."

questions.question: The fear of man lays a snare, but whoever trusts in the Lord is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 29:25 (ESV): "but whoever trusts in the Lord is safe."

questions.question: By justice a king builds up the land, but he who exacts gifts tears it what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 29:4 (ESV): "but he who exacts gifts tears it down."

questions.question: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 29:5 (ESV): "spreads a net for his feet."

questions.question: The righteous knows the rights of the poor; a wicked man does not understand such what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 29:7 (ESV): "a wicked man does not understand such knowledge."

questions.question: Scoffers set a city aflame, but wise men turn away what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 29:8 (ESV): "but wise men turn away wrath."

questions.question: If a wise man has an argument with a fool, the fool only rages and laughs, and there is no what?
Bloodthirsty men hate one who is blameless and seek the life of the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 29:10 (ESV): "and seek the life of the upright."

questions.question: If a ruler listens to falsehood, all his officials will be what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 29:12 (ESV): "all his officials will be wicked."

questions.question: The poor man and the oppressor meet together; the Lord gives light to the eyes of whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 29:13 (ESV): "the Lord gives light to the eyes of both."

questions.question: The rod and reproof give wisdom, but a child left to himself brings shame to his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 29:15 (ESV): "but a child left to himself brings shame to his mother."

questions.question: Where there is no prophetic vision the people cast off restraint, but blessed is he who keeps the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 29:18 (ESV): "but blessed is he who keeps the law."

key_verse_text: He who is often reproved, yet stiffens his neck, will suddenly be broken beyond healing, and that without remedy.
